title: Unemployment Benefit Claims — Verification Days on a Payment Election after Recent Identity Verification
content:
Verification days are business days added to the election lead time of a payment election on an Unemployment Benefit Claims record when the claim's Claimant Identity Verification record shows a recent verification. The record read is the verified date of each identity verification case on the claim and the pathway the case is on.

## Verification days

| Claimant Identity Verification record of the claim | Verification days |
|---|---|
| The most recently verified Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification case on the claim was verified within the 30 days before the handling date | 3 |
| No such re-verification was verified within those 30 days, and the most recently verified identity verification case on the claim, of whatever pathway, was verified within those 30 days | 1 |
| No identity verification case on the claim was verified within those 30 days | None |

"Within the 30 days before the handling date" means a verified date no more than 30 calendar days before the handling date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Most recently verified case on the claim | Days before the handling date | Verification days |
|---|---|---|
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | 30 | 3 |
| Identity Theft Victim Re-Verification | 31 | None |
| Online Identity Proofing (IAL2) | 12 | 1 |
| In-Person Proofing — American Job Center | 45 | None |
